_comment: Expected applicant notices for the notice tests. Derived by hand from rules/reason_codes.toml wording (catalog section 3), config/notice_frame.toml and docs/data-dictionary.md section 4. For N-TV7 the exact ratio is 0.50001, so the text says 50.01 (ceiling); if the trace only holds 0.5000 the notice cannot be right and the agent must stop and report (prompt step 0). Never edit to make a test pass. Fields starting with an underscore are for the reader and are ignored by the test.
